name: semantic_contrast_v0_3_lite_approach_vs_static_paired
description: v0.3-lite paired contrast for unchanged scene position versus another entity moving into the scene.

static_scene.text: A person stands beside a mailbox on a quiet sidewalk. A parked van remains across the street.
Someone waits near a fountain in a plaza. A small cart remains beside the fountain.
A person pauses near a garden gate. A bicycle remains beside the fence.
Someone stands by a bus stop sign. A taxi remains at the curb.
A person looks across a warehouse aisle. A pallet remains at the far end.
Someone stands in a station corridor. A luggage cart remains near the wall.
A person pauses at the edge of a courtyard. A maintenance cart remains by the planter.
Someone waits beside a loading dock. A delivery truck remains at the far bay.
A person stands near a hallway window. A janitor cart remains near the elevator.
Someone pauses on a gravel path. A wheelbarrow remains beside the shed.

approaching_agent.text: A person stands beside a mailbox on a quiet sidewalk. A van rolls toward the curb across the street.
Someone waits near a fountain in a plaza. A small cart rolls toward the fountain.
A person pauses near a garden gate. A bicycle rolls along the fence line.
Someone stands by a bus stop sign. A taxi rolls toward the curb.
A person looks across a warehouse aisle. A pallet jack rolls down the aisle.
Someone stands in a station corridor. A luggage cart rolls along the wall.
A person pauses at the edge of a courtyard. A maintenance cart rolls past the planter.
Someone waits beside a loading dock. A delivery truck rolls into the far bay.
A person stands near a hallway window. A janitor cart rolls out of the elevator area.
Someone pauses on a gravel path. A wheelbarrow rolls away from the shed.
